entries.1f3e214e7aa20cca: Operators of public and private plants
entries.2c876858783a9091: A comprehensive rental company that rents industrial machinery, construction machinery, industrial vehicles and the like, providing them together with value-added services such as maintenance and calibration.
entries.540e62551fcb09f0: This is the group's only reportable segment. It provides approximately 7,000 types and more than 660,000 units of rental assets (ownership ratio by category: vehicles 28%, aerial work vehicles and machinery 23%, excavators and road paving machinery 16%, lifting and transport machinery 11%, generators, compressors and environmental products 10%, tools and electrical and surveying equipment 6%, lighting, safety equipment and materials 6%) from the company's 69 domestic sales offices and from subsidiaries in Thailand, Indonesia and Vietnam. Approximately 61% of rental revenue comes from customers outside the construction industry. Within the group, Rent Sogo Service Co., Ltd., Atex Co., Ltd. and Max Line Co., Ltd. handle delivery of rental assets, Sanko Tosou Bankin Kogyo Co., Ltd. and Kanagawa Sekiyu Hanbai Co., Ltd. handle maintenance and repairs, and Rent Trade & Service Co., Ltd. in Thailand handles procurement and delivery and the dispatch of machine operators.
entries.9290831e5611963e: Headquartered in Shizuoka City, Shizuoka Prefecture, the group comprises a total of 12 companies: the company, 8 consolidated subsidiaries and 3 equity-method affiliates.

entries.ffc92a6a79628537: Headquartered in Shizuoka City, Shizuoka Prefecture, the group comprises a total of 12 companies: the company, 8 consolidated subsidiaries and 3 equity-method affiliates. Its main business is renting industrial machinery, construction machinery, industrial vehicles and other equipment, and the consolidated number of employees for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was 1,752. It listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange in June 2025.
